psychotic.name: Schizophrenia spectrum and other psychotic disorders

medication.name: Medication-induced movement disorders and other adverse effects of medication

other.name: Other conditions that may be a focus of clinical attention

pmr.label: Psychomotor slowing
pmr.def: Slow, few movements: slumped, little gesture, slow to start.

pma.label: Psychomotor agitation
pma.def: Restless, can't stay seated: pacing, wringing hands, picking.

selfcare.label: Poor self-care
selfcare.def: Unwashed, unkempt or stained clothes, out of keeping with their usual standard.

kempt.label: Well kempt, appropriate
kempt.def: Clean and dressed for the setting. A normal finding worth writing down.

posturing.label: Posturing
posturing.def: Holds an odd, often uncomfortable position for a long time, on their own.

waxy.label: Waxy flexibility
waxy.def: Limbs stay where the examiner places them, with a slight even resistance, like soft wax.

stereotypy.label: Stereotypy
stereotypy.def: The same movement repeated again and again, with no goal at all.

mannerism.label: Mannerism
mannerism.def: An odd, stylised way of doing a normal, goal-directed action (a strange salute before shaking hands).

guarded.label: Guarded, suspicious
guarded.def: Watchful, checks the room, reluctant to answer.

tremor.label: Tremor and sweating
tremor.def: Shaky hands, sweating, fast pulse: the body in alarm, often withdrawal.

compulsion.label: Compulsive act
compulsion.def: A repeated act done to calm the anxiety of an obsession, which the person knows is excessive.

responding.label: Responding to unseen voices
responding.def: Pauses, glances aside, mutters or smiles as if listening to someone the examiner can't hear.

pressured.label: Pressured speech
pressured.def: Fast, loud, hard to interrupt; the words pour out.

latency.label: Slowed speech, long pauses
latency.def: Long gaps before answers, quiet and slow, with little tone.

poverty.label: Poverty of speech
poverty.def: Very few words: brief answers, nothing added unless asked.

mutism.label: Mutism
mutism.def: No speech at all while awake and alert.

normalspeech.label: Normal rate, tone and volume
normalspeech.def: Nothing unusual in how the words come out.

neologism.label: Neologism
neologism.def: A made-up word, or a real word given a private meaning the listener can't share.

echolalia.label: Echolalia
echolalia.def: Repeats the examiner's words back, like an echo.

lowmood.label: Low mood
lowmood.def: In their own words, sad, empty or hopeless most of the time.

elated.label: Elated mood
elated.def: In their own words, on top of the world, better than ever.

irritable.label: Irritable mood
irritable.def: In their own words, easily annoyed, short-tempered.

anxiousmood.label: Anxious mood
anxiousmood.def: In their own words, tense, on edge, frightened.

euthymic.label: Euthymic mood
euthymic.def: In their own words, their mood is in the ordinary range.

reactive.label: Reactive, full range
reactive.def: The face and voice move with the topic: smiles at a joke, sad at a loss.

restricted.label: Restricted affect
restricted.def: A narrowed range of expression, still in the right direction.

blunted.label: Blunted affect
blunted.def: Emotional response clearly reduced and dulled, with social subtlety lost; there is still a little, in the right direction.

flat.label: Flat affect
flat.def: Almost no emotional expression in any direction: still face, monotone, even for big news.

incongruent.label: Incongruent affect
incongruent.def: The emotion shown doesn't fit what is being said, and the person isn't aware of it (laughs while describing a death).

labile.label: Labile affect
labile.def: Swings quickly and out of proportion: tears, then laughter, within a minute.

tearful.label: Low, tearful affect
tearful.def: Sad face and tears that match what they are saying.

anxiousaffect.label: Anxious affect
anxiousaffect.def: Tense face, shaky voice, fidgeting: fear you can see.

embarrassed.label: Embarrassed smile (not incongruity)
embarrassed.def: A social or anxious smile while telling something painful. Understandable, the person knows it; this is not incongruity.

elatedaffect.label: Elated, expansive affect
elatedaffect.def: Beaming, laughing, over-familiar: happiness you can see, more than the situation explains.

circumstantial.label: Circumstantial
circumstantial.def: Lots of needless detail and side-paths, but the point is finally reached.

tangential.label: Tangential
tangential.def: Drifts off to a related topic and never comes back to the question.

foi.label: Flight of ideas
foi.def: Fast thoughts jumping by chance links (rhymes, puns, things in the room). You can usually follow each jump.

loosening.label: Loosening of association
loosening.def: Ideas slide between topics with no link you can follow, at normal speed (derailment).

block.label: Thought block
block.def: The thought stops dead mid-sentence; the person can't pick it up and may say the thought was taken.

perseveration.label: Perseveration
perseveration.def: The same answer or idea comes back after the question has moved on.

clang.label: Clang association
clang.def: Words chosen by sound or rhyme instead of meaning.

wordsalad.label: Word salad
wordsalad.def: Words strung together with no grammar or meaning.

slowedthought.label: Slowed thinking
slowedthought.def: Few ideas, slow to come, hard to decide. Common in depression.

goaldirected.label: Goal-directed
goaldirected.def: Logical and coherent; reaches the point. A normal finding.

prolixity.label: Prolixity (ordered flight)
prolixity.def: Lively, quick side-trips, but returns to the goal within moments. Seen in hypomania.

persecutory.label: Persecutory delusion
persecutory.def: A fixed, false belief of being harmed or plotted against, held despite evidence and out of keeping with culture.

reference.label: Delusion of reference
reference.def: Fixed belief that ordinary events (TV, strangers, number plates) carry messages meant for them.

grandiose.label: Grandiose delusion
grandiose.def: Fixed belief of special powers, wealth, mission or identity.

guilt.label: Delusion of guilt
guilt.def: Fixed belief of having done something terrible, far beyond any real fault.

nihilistic.label: Nihilistic delusion
nihilistic.def: Fixed belief that they, their organs or the world are dead, rotting or gone.

jealousy.label: Delusion of jealousy
jealousy.def: Fixed belief that the partner is unfaithful, 'proved' by trivial signs.

overvalued.label: Overvalued idea
overvalued.def: An understandable, emotionally charged belief that dominates life. Less fixed and less impossible than a delusion; often shared by others in the culture.

obsession.label: Obsession
obsession.def: An unwanted, intrusive thought the person knows is their own, finds senseless and tries to resist.

insertion.label: Thought insertion
insertion.def: Thoughts put into the mind from outside; the person says they are not their own.

broadcast.label: Thought broadcasting
broadcast.def: Their thoughts spread out of their head so others know them.

withdrawal.label: Thought withdrawal
withdrawal.def: Thoughts are taken out of the mind by an outside force.

passivity.label: Made actions (passivity)
passivity.def: Actions, feelings or impulses controlled by an outside force; they feel like a puppet.

delperception.label: Delusional perception
delperception.def: A normal perception suddenly given a new, private, delusional meaning with no understandable link.

passiveSI.label: Passive death wish
passiveSI.def: Wishes to be dead or not wake up, without a plan or intent.

activeSI.label: Suicidal thoughts with a plan
activeSI.def: Thinks of ending life and has a method, a time or preparations.

preoccupation.label: Preoccupation
preoccupation.def: A theme they keep returning to, which is not a false belief (grief, money worries).

worry.label: Excessive worry
worry.def: Hard-to-control worry about many everyday things.

noabn.label: No abnormal beliefs
noabn.def: No delusions, obsessions or risk thoughts found. A normal finding.

ah2.label: Second-person voice
ah2.def: A voice speaking to them ('you are...'), heard outside, through the ears, as real as speech.

ah3.label: Third-person voices (commentary)
ah3.def: Voices talk about them ('he is going out now'), often commenting on actions.

command.label: Command hallucination
command.def: A heard voice that tells them to do something. Always ask about it in a risk check.

pseudo.label: Pseudo-hallucination
pseudo.def: Vivid and involuntary, but experienced inside the head (inner space) and known not to be a real perception.

illusion.label: Illusion
illusion.def: A real thing is misperceived (a coat on a hook seen as a person), often in fear or poor light, and it corrects on a closer look.

pareidolia.label: Pareidolia
pareidolia.def: Vivid images seen in vague shapes (faces in clouds or stains), without effort, known not to be real.

hypnagogic.label: Hypnagogic hallucination
hypnagogic.def: A brief voice or image while falling asleep. Common and often normal.

vh.label: Visual hallucination
vh.def: Sees things with no stimulus at all. Points to delirium, drugs, withdrawal or Lewy body disease more than schizophrenia.

tactile.label: Tactile hallucination
tactile.def: Feels touch with no stimulus, like insects crawling under the skin (formication).

depersonalisation.label: Depersonalisation
depersonalisation.def: Feels unreal or detached from self, 'as if' a robot, and knows it is only a feeling.

derealisation.label: Derealisation
derealisation.def: The world feels unreal, flat, like a film set, and they know it isn't really changed.

noperc.label: No perceptual abnormality
noperc.def: No hallucinations or illusions found. A normal finding.

disoriented.label: Disoriented
disoriented.def: Wrong about time, place or person.

oriented.label: Oriented, attention intact
oriented.def: Knows time, place and person; holds attention. A normal finding.

inattention.label: Poor attention
inattention.def: Can't hold or shift attention: fails months backwards or serial sevens, loses the question.

clouding.label: Clouded, fluctuating consciousness
clouding.def: Drowsy or muddled, better and worse across the day. The heart of delirium.

recentmem.label: Impaired recent memory
recentmem.def: Can't recall new information after a few minutes.

confabulation.label: Confabulation
confabulation.def: Fills memory gaps with invented stories the person believes, without intent to deceive.

fullinsight.label: Full insight
fullinsight.def: Knows these are symptoms of an illness and accepts help.

partialinsight.label: Partial insight
partialinsight.def: Some awareness (knows something is wrong) but rejects part of it, such as the illness label or medicines.

noinsight.label: No insight
noinsight.def: Sees nothing wrong with themselves; the problem is all outside.

poorjudgement.label: Impaired judgement
poorjudgement.def: Decisions that put them or others at risk, out of character.

akathisia.label: Akathisia
akathisia.def: A driven inner restlessness, mostly in the legs, usually after an antipsychotic is started or raised: shifts weight, crosses and uncrosses legs, gets up and sits down, and says the legs will not keep still.

dystonia.label: Acute dystonia
dystonia.def: A sudden, sustained, often painful muscle spasm (neck twisted, eyes rolled up, jaw or tongue locked), usually in the first days of an antipsychotic.

parkinsonism.label: Drug-induced parkinsonism
parkinsonism.def: Stiff, slow and shuffling, with a mask-like face and a resting tremor, after antipsychotic treatment.

tic.label: Tic
tic.def: A sudden, quick, repeated, non-rhythmic movement or sound (blink, shrug, sniff, grunt), often preceded by an urge and held back for a while with effort.

negativism.label: Negativism
negativism.def: Motiveless resistance to every instruction or attempt to move them, or doing the exact opposite.

echopraxia.label: Echopraxia
echopraxia.def: Copies the examiner's movements automatically, without being asked.

obedience.label: Automatic obedience
obedience.def: Carries out every instruction at once and literally, even ones that are odd or that they were told to refuse.

ambitendency.label: Ambitendency
ambitendency.def: Starts a movement, stops, starts again, unable to complete it (holds out a hand, pulls it back, holds it out again).

stupor.label: Stupor
stupor.def: Awake but almost no movement, speech or response to the surroundings, with eyes that may still follow you.

hypervigilant.label: Hypervigilance, startle
hypervigilant.def: Keeps scanning the room and jumps at small sounds: a body on guard, often after trauma.

disinhibited.label: Disinhibited, overfamiliar
disinhibited.def: Loses ordinary social restraint: crude jokes, over-friendly with strangers, touching, out of keeping with the setting.

hostile.label: Hostile, uncooperative
hostile.def: Angry, argumentative or threatening towards the examiner, refuses to engage.

withdrawn.label: Withdrawn, poor eye contact
withdrawn.def: Avoids eye contact, turns away, engages very little, without the watchfulness of suspicion.

selfharm.label: Signs of self-harm
selfharm.def: Visible cuts, scars or burns, often on the forearms or thighs, sometimes at different stages of healing.

emaciated.label: Emaciated, very low weight
emaciated.def: Visibly wasted face and limbs, loose clothes, sunken cheeks: an urgent physical finding to act on.

intox.label: Signs of intoxication
intox.def: Smell of alcohol, slurred speech, unsteady gait, flushed face, or very small or very wide pupils.

bizarredress.label: Odd, out-of-place dress
bizarredress.def: Clothing strikingly unusual for the setting and season (three sweaters in May, foil in a cap) with no cultural or practical reason.

chorea.label: Choreiform movements
chorea.def: Brief, irregular, flowing jerks that move from one part of the body to another, with no urge before them and often unnoticed by the person.

myoclonus.label: Myoclonus
myoclonus.def: Sudden, shock-like jerks of a muscle or limb, seen in toxic states such as serotonin toxicity and in some brain diseases.

cooperative.label: Cooperative, good rapport
cooperative.def: Engages easily, answers openly and warms to the examiner. A normal finding worth writing down.

dysarthria.label: Dysarthria
dysarthria.def: Words are badly formed (slurred, thick, explosive) because of a motor problem; the language itself is intact.

dysphasia.label: Nominal dysphasia
dysphasia.def: Cannot find the names of things and talks around them ('the thing you tell time with'): a brain-based language problem.

stammer.label: Stammer
stammer.def: Repeats, stretches or blocks on sounds with visible effort, while what they mean to say is normal.

verbigeration.label: Verbigeration
verbigeration.def: The same words or sentence repeated over and over without meaning, often in a monotone, not in answer to anything.

palilalia.label: Palilalia
palilalia.def: Repeats their own last word or phrase again and again, often faster each time.

monotone.label: Monotonous tone
monotone.def: Little rise and fall in the voice, while the amount and speed of speech are ordinary.

dysphoric.label: Dysphoric mood
dysphoric.def: In their own words, an unpleasant mix of misery, tension and irritability.

anhedonia.label: Anhedonia
anhedonia.def: In their own words, no pleasure or interest in things they used to enjoy.

apathy.label: Apathy
apathy.def: Says they have no drive and care little either way, without the sadness of low mood.

numbness.label: Emotional numbness
numbness.def: Says they cannot feel love, grief or joy, as if cut off from their own emotions, and suffers from it.

perplexed.label: Perplexed affect
perplexed.def: A bewildered, puzzled face and manner, as if the world has suddenly changed and nothing makes sense.

shallow.label: Shallow affect
shallow.def: Emotions shown are thin, brief and empty (a silly, fatuous cheerfulness) rather than reduced.

irritableaffect.label: Irritable affect
irritableaffect.def: Tight jaw, sharp tone, quick to snap: annoyance you can see in the room.

overinclusion.label: Overinclusion
overinclusion.def: Cannot keep the edges of an idea or category: pulls in loosely related things that do not belong.

concrete.label: Concrete thinking
concrete.def: Takes words, proverbs and metaphors literally and cannot move to the abstract meaning.

metonym.label: Metonym
metonym.def: An odd, approximate phrase used in place of the exact word, built from ordinary words ('I ate the three-times-a-day').

povertycontent.label: Poverty of content
povertycontent.def: Talks a normal amount but conveys almost nothing: vague, empty, repetitive.

vorbeireden.label: Approximate answers
vorbeireden.def: Wrong answers that show the question was understood (a cow has five legs, two plus two is five), as in Ganser states.

hypochondriacal.label: Health preoccupation
hypochondriacal.def: Persistent fear of having a serious illness despite normal tests and reassurance, which the person can still doubt a little. Not a fixed delusion.

somaticdel.label: Somatic delusion
somaticdel.def: A fixed, false belief about the body: infested, giving off a smell, misshapen, a part not working.

erotomanic.label: Erotomanic delusion
erotomanic.def: A fixed belief that someone, often of higher status, is secretly in love with them.

capgras.label: Delusional misidentification
capgras.def: A fixed belief that a familiar person has been replaced by an identical impostor (Capgras), or that a stranger is someone known in disguise.

povertydel.label: Delusion of poverty
povertydel.def: A fixed belief of being ruined and penniless despite clear evidence otherwise, typical of severe depression.

primary.label: Autochthonous delusion
primary.def: A delusion that arrives suddenly and fully formed, out of the blue, with no perception or mood that leads to it.

ideasref.label: Ideas of reference
ideasref.def: A feeling that others notice or talk about them, which the person can still question ('maybe I am imagining it'). Not fixed.

phobia.label: Phobia
phobia.def: A marked fear of a specific object or situation, out of proportion, which the person recognises and avoids.

rumination.label: Depressive rumination
rumination.def: Turning the same sad or self-blaming thoughts over and over, felt as true and not resisted as senseless.

homicidal.label: Thoughts of harming others
homicidal.def: Thoughts, urges or plans to hurt someone else. Always ask about the target, plan, intent and access.

dysmorphic.label: Appearance preoccupation
dysmorphic.def: Hours of focus on a defect in looks that others see as slight or absent, with checking and hiding.

selfharmthoughts.label: Self-harm thoughts
selfharmthoughts.def: Urges or thoughts to injure themselves (cutting, burning) to cope with feelings, without wanting to die.

olfactory.label: Olfactory hallucination
olfactory.def: Smells something with no source (burning, rotting, gas).

gustatory.label: Gustatory hallucination
gustatory.def: Tastes something with no source (metal, bitter poison in food).

somatichall.label: Somatic hallucination
somatichall.def: Feels bodily sensations with no cause: organs moving, electric currents, being touched inside.

echo.label: Thought echo
echo.def: Hears their own thoughts spoken aloud, as or just after they think them.

functional.label: Functional hallucination
functional.def: A real sound brings on a hallucination in the same sense, heard alongside it (voices only while the tap runs).

reflex.label: Reflex hallucination
reflex.def: A stimulus in one sense causes a hallucination in another (feels a stab in the chest whenever a door bangs).

extracampine.label: Extracampine hallucination
extracampine.def: Perceived outside the possible sensory field (sees a man standing behind their head, hears voices from another city).

hypnopompic.label: Hypnopompic hallucination
hypnopompic.def: A brief image or voice on waking up. Often normal.

autoscopy.label: Autoscopy
autoscopy.def: Sees a double of themselves, their own body, outside them.

distortion.label: Sensory distortion
distortion.def: Real things look or sound changed in size, colour, intensity or quality (sounds deafening, colours too bright, objects too small).

amnesia.label: Dissociative amnesia
amnesia.def: A gap in personal memory, usually for a stressful period, too large for ordinary forgetting and with no brain cause found.

executive.label: Poor executive function
executive.def: Cannot plan, switch tasks or stop a response: fails sequences and gets stuck on the last rule.

dontknow.label: Poor effort, 'don't know' answers
dontknow.def: Gives up quickly with 'I don't know', yet does better with encouragement. Typical of depression, not dementia.

goodjudgement.label: Intact judgement
goodjudgement.def: Makes sensible, safe decisions for their situation. A normal finding.

explanatory.label: Different explanatory model
explanatory.def: Explains the problem in a cultural frame (nazar, a spell, weakness of nerves) while still accepting help: a different model, not absent insight.
